meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码库、命令或改动拆成一步步图解,讲给完全不懂的人听
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里有人不是工程师,却需要快速弄懂某段代码或某次改动。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if someone on your team must grasp code without being an engineer.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读代码,产出一个 PR Lens 画布:先定一句话结论,再让画面一屏一屏长大,读者打开链接按播放,最后看到全貌。
howto.when: 当你说 /eli5 <对象>,或要求把代码讲给初学者、新同事、非工程人员听,或说「像跟五岁小孩解释」时,由它接管。

say.note: 会生成一个逐步展开的 PR Lens 画布链接

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the code and writes a PR Lens canvas: one answer sentence first, then views that grow one part at a time. The reader opens a link and presses play.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /eli5 <thing>, or when you ask for code explained simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or "like I'm five".

say_en.note: Produces a PR Lens canvas link that grows step by step

say_en.text: Explain this feature to someone who knows nothing about code
say_en.note: One answer sentence first, then views that build up
